---
title: "Map"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
attacks <- read_csv("data/attacks_clean.csv") |>
  mutate(
    Country_lower = str_to_lower(str_trim(Country)),
    Fatal_clean = case_when(
      Fatal == "Y" ~ "Fatal",
      Fatal == "N" ~ "Non-fatal",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    )
  )
write_rds(attacks, "data/attacks.rds")
```

```{r}
world <- map_data("world") |>
  mutate(region = str_to_lower(region)) |>
  left_join(
    attacks |> count(Country_lower, name = "attacks"),
    by = c("region" = "Country_lower")
  )

ggplot(world, aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group, fill = attacks)) +
  geom_polygon(color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  coord_quickmap() +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "lightyellow",
    high = "darkred",
    na.value = "grey90",
    name = "Attacks"
  ) +
  labs(title = "Shark attacks by country")
```

```{r}
attacks |>
  count(Fatal_clean, name = "attacks")
```
